description: Read the active PCB (open one with pcb_do action:'open'). what: 'info' (layers, rule set, outline size, counts), 'parts' (components; pads:true adds pad coordinates and nets), 'tracks', 'vias', 'shapes' (polylines, pours, regions, fills, texts), 'nets' (pads, track length, tracks and vias per net; `net` for one), 'unrouted' (pads still waiting for a connection), 'drc' (design rule check with the list of errors). Coordinates are in mil with y up; unit:'mm' switches to millimetres.

layer.description: tracks: layer number or name (top, bottom, topsilk, outline, inner1...).

max.description: drc: how many errors to list (default 60).

net.description: tracks, vias, nets: only this net.

name: pcb_read
